assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing converts a chemical reaction (cytidine and adenosine deamination) into a programmable, double-strand-break-free genome edit; it is a general tool that biologists adopted widely and it has reached clinical use. Rational enzyme and protein engineering underlies it, including evolved TadA for A-to-G editing.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the work, with Komor (C-to-T editor) and Gaudelli (A-to-G editor) as the first-author discoverers of the two editor classes; Kondo and Nishida's independent deaminase-fusion work is a real competing claim, but the three-name set is defensible. Overlap with the prime-editing line is a possible complication.
assessment.maturity: Many independent groups have reproduced and extended it, and clinical-stage trials are underway; the editing outcome spectrum is well characterised. Timing is plausible but recognition could be premature relative to clinical outcomes.
uncertainties: Whether the committee would treat base editing and prime editing as one Liu-centred award
Credit of Kondo and Nishida for the independent early deaminase fusion
Long-term off-target and bystander editing data remain limited

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Sequencing-by-synthesis with reversibly terminated, fluorescent nucleotides is chemistry-based and transformed all of biology and medicine, including measurements of nucleic acids and nucleotide metabolism. The impact is broad and enduring.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman originated the Solexa chemistry; Rothberg (pyrosequencing and Ion Torrent) and Mayer are tied to other strategies and could be argued as separate branches, so a two-name prize is cleanest. The 'massively parallel sequencing' label spans several commercial technologies, which complicates credit.
assessment.maturity: The impact is a decade-plus mature and the technology is globally validated. Recognition is, if anything, overdue.
uncertainties: Whether the committee wants the Solexa chemistry alone or the wider field including pyrosequencing
Role of industry team members in the Solexa development is hard to apportion from the supplied credit

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hijacking the ubiquitin-proteasome machinery with bifunctional molecules or molecular glues turns a biological pathway into a chemically controllable event, with direct therapeutic relevance. It is a new modality, with several degraders in clinical trials.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived the PROTAC concept and made the first PROTACs; Handa and collaborators identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which grounds molecular glues. Ciulli and Gray extended the work substantially, so the cut is difficult and the molecular-glue and PROTAC halves may need different people.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent reproduction and many clinical programmes, but no approved PROTAC drug is evident from the supplied information, so the clinical proof is not yet complete.
uncertainties: Approved-drug evidence for PROTACs is lacking
Allocation between PROTAC and molecular-glue lines (Ciulli, Gray, Handa, Ito)
I am relying on my background knowledge for clinical status

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible RNA methylation, with writers, erasers and readers of m6A, defines a chemical layer of gene regulation, analogous to DNA and histone marks, with relevance to development, cancer and stability of RNA. It fits my interest in chemistry underlying biology.
assessment.attribution: He proposed and demonstrated reversibility via FTO/ALKBH5 demethylation with Jia; Rechavi and Jaffrey independently mapped m6A transcriptome-wide in 2012 with Dominissini and Meyer. A three-name set is plausible, but trainee roles (Jia, Dominissini, Meyer) and Yang's ALKBH5 work complicate the picture.
assessment.maturity: Confirmed by many groups, but some mapping methods and the physiological significance of specific sites have been contested, and the interpretation is still being refined.
uncertainties: Disagreement over mapping accuracy and antibody specificity
Credit distribution among He, Jaffrey, Rechavi and ALKBH5 co-discoverers Yang and Zheng
Whether the field is stable enough yet

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetically encoding noncanonical amino acids with orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs makes chemistry programmable inside living cells, a general tool used for biophysics, proteins and therapeutics. The idea is original and has lasting impact.
assessment.attribution: Schultz created the first orthogonal pair for unnatural amino acid incorporation in E. coli and in yeast and mammalian cells; Chin extended the approach to multiple code, quadruplet decoding and ribosome engineering. Lei Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama had major contributions, so a prize would have to exclude some.
assessment.maturity: Highly reproducible, in wide use and mature.
uncertainties: Exclusion of Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama may be hard to defend
Whether the committee views this as a tool or a conceptual discovery

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation as an organising principle for membraneless compartments changed how cell biologists think about intracellular chemistry, and links to disease. The conceptual impact is substantial.
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman showed P granules behave as liquids in 2009; Rosen, Pappu and Mittag supplied biophysical and sequence-grammar frameworks. A fair award would be difficult with more than three names.
assessment.maturity: As an experimentalist I am wary: the field is young, and in-cell evidence versus in-vitro droplets is debated, with some claims not reproduced under physiological concentrations. Interpretation is not yet stable.
uncertainties: Whether in vitro droplets reflect physiological condensates
Allocation between the cell-biology and the physical-chemistry contributions
Possibly premature

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Activity-based probes report on the functional state of enzymes in complex proteomes, a mechanism-based chemical approach that gives biologists a general tool and enabled drug discovery against uncharacterised enzymes.
assessment.attribution: Cravatt is the clear originator of the proteome-wide approach, alongside Bogyo for cysteine protease probes, and Overkleeft and Weerapana for important extensions. Credit for the earliest probes (for example Bogyo and Overkleeft) and later cysteine profiling is distributed.
assessment.maturity: The method is widely reproduced and mature, and chemical-proteomic discovery campaigns have delivered inhibitors with clinical interest.
uncertainties: Whether Cravatt alone would be preferred
Credit for earlier covalent probe concepts

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase turns N2 into ammonia at a unique FeMo-cofactor; the structure of the cofactor with its interstitial carbide and the mechanistic work on intermediate states is a central bioinorganic problem and a clear enzyme chemistry story with relevance to nutrient cycles.
assessment.attribution: Rees led crystallography of the MoFe protein and the cofactor; Einsle resolved the interstitial atom at high resolution; Dean, Seefeldt and Ribbe contributed genetics, spectroscopy, mechanism and cofactor biosynthesis. Five credited names exceed three, so the choice is hard.
assessment.maturity: The structural picture is well-confirmed independently, but the catalytic mechanism and the substrate binding mode are still being debated, so only the structure part is mature.
uncertainties: Catalytic mechanism is not fully settled
Who among Rees, Einsle, Dean, Seefeldt and Ribbe has the decisive contribution is unclear
